jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager
About Userlane

Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally.

Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications.


Your mission

Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as:

  • Defining metrics that hold up: Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete.

  • Delivering outcome-linked metrics: Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on

  • Building for time-poor executives: Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?"

  • Connecting fragmented data sources: Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems,

  • Transforming insights into action: Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once

  • AI adoption governance: Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation

  • You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't.

  • You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?"

  • You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does.

  • You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight

  • You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus

  • You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product

  • You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike

  • You're fluent in English (spoken and written)


What's in for you

  • Team & Culture: A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries

  • Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems

  • Product strategy influence: Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors

  • Market: Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry

  • Growth: We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training
    Benefits: We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure

jobs.title: R&D Engineer - Optical Systems & Single-Photon Source Lithography
jobs.description:
R&D Engineer - Optical Systems & Single-Photon Source Lithography

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

About this position:

We are looking for a R&D Engineer - Optical Systems & Single-Photon Source Lithography to support the development of novel designs of Single Photon Sources (SPS) for Quandela’s SPS R&D department.  

This position combines advanced optical experiments, hands-on R&D, and manufacturing engineering. The SPSL Engineer will play a key role in the fabrication of new designs of SPSs, that will be further tested by colleagues on characterization testbenches. 

The role will have a strong focus on in-situ localization of quantum dots (QDs) at cryogenic temperatures and lithography over the localized QDs with laser writing techniques. The successful candidate will work closely with our SPS R&D team, SPS production team, fabrication engineers, equipment owners, and cleanroom operators to improve performance of the SPSs and successfully transfer R&D advances to our production mainline. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of optics and semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology, and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key responsibilities

  • Improving SPS performance 
    • Develop, optimize and stabilize QD positioning and laser lithography process on R&D “experimental” epitaxial wafer growths with high-performance potential. 
    • Contribute to the development of GUIs and automation software in the Python programming language. 
    • Contribute to the development of fully automated QD-positioning and lithography tools on complex, “experimental” epitaxial wafer growths. 
    • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
    • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness, and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • R&D to Production Transfer 
    • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes, and production volumes. 
    • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transferring to production. 
    • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
    • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training, and technical communication. 
    • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations, and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Equipment & Production Support 
    • Contribute to the development of novel fabrication setups, both on the hardware and software side. 
    • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
    • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 
  • Process Characterization & Data Analysis 
    • Develop appropriate data analysis tools to identify process sensitivities, and optimization opportunities. 
    • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support experiments development and troubleshooting. 
  • Documentation & Communication 
    • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
    • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience :

  • Master's degree or PhD in Optics, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Hands-on experience in design, assembling, and alignment of optical systems. 
  • Hands-on experience in design, assembling, and operation of electronic devices 
  • Python programming language fluency. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications :

  • Experience in development of GUIs with the Python programming language. 
  • Good understanding of quantum physics in general and more specifically of quantum optics. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators, or VCSEL-type technologies. 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new systems where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, developing Python projects, solving complex fabrication problems, and collaborating across R&D and production teams.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

    • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
    • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
    • Use Case / Practical Assessment : The use case will consist of a simple practical exercise focused on the alignment of an optical bench. The assessment will take place in the cleanroom, they are not considered PPE for this exercise.
    • Meeting with the teams
    • 2 reference check
    • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

Enseignante Chercheuse ou Enseignant Chercheur (Maître de conférences)  Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs en CDI à IMT Nord Europe
jobs.description:
Enseignante Chercheuse ou Enseignant Chercheur (Maître de conférences) Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs en CDI à IMT Nord Europe

INTITULÉ : « Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs ».

SPÉCIALITÉS : « Qualité de l'air intérieur, Physico-chimie de l'air, Performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments ».

ÉTABLISSEMENT D'AFFECTATION :

École Nationale Supérieure Mines-Télécom Lille Douai dont le nom d'usage est IMT Nord Europe.

Direction / Service : Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE)

Responsable hiérarchique : Directrice du CERI Énergie Environnement

Catégorie : Agent de catégorie A ou contractuel cadre de gestion de catégorie II

Nature du poste : CDI

Lieu de travail : Site de Douai. Des déplacements sur les autres sites de l'École sont à prévoir

CONTEXTE

École sous tutelle du ministère de l'économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, et école de l'Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l'innovation et les créations d'entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l'Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1h30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l'ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l'ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d'enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s'appuie sur plus de 20 000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d'excellence dans les domaines suivants :

•      Énergie Environnement

•      Systèmes Numériques

•      Matériaux et Procédés

L'École dispose également d'antennes à Dunkerque, Valenciennes et Alençon.

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l'Ecole : www.imt-nord-europe.fr

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE) (https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/).

Le CERI EE développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l'efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. Le CERI est structuré en trois axes thématiques : EFT (Énergie, Fluides et Transferts), OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques) et QEI (Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs).

L'axe thématique QEI porte sur l'étude, l'identification et la caractérisation des sources de polluants dans les espaces clos et/ou confinés, l'analyse des interactions entre l'air intérieur et les matériaux, ainsi que l'étude de l'influence des environnements sur l'exposition et le bien-être des occupants. Les enjeux scientifiques traités couvrent plusieurs échelles, depuis l'intégration de matériaux et de systèmes énergétiques innovants jusqu'à leurs impacts sur les espaces intérieurs et leurs occupants. Dans un contexte marqué par le changement climatique et des exigences croissantes en termes de QEI et d'efficacité énergétique, une attention particulière est portée aux stratégies d'adaptation et d'atténuation, ainsi qu'aux rôles du comportement des occupants et des différentes sources d'exposition.

Ce poste vise à renforcer et développer l'axe thématique QEI au sein du CERI. La QEI intègre l'étude de multiples paramètres de confort (température, hygrométrie, bruit, luminosité) et de composition de l'air dans les environnements clos (logements, espaces de travail, transports, etc.), afin d'assurer bien-être et santé des occupants. Ces environnements doivent concilier les transitions environnementales et énergétiques avec la qualité de l'air et le confort des occupants.

L'ambition est de consolider le positionnement d'IMT Nord Europe dans ce domaine, avec une synergie entre recherche et formation. Il s'agit de renforcer un réseau de recherche et d'enseignement interdisciplinaire sur cette thématique en réponse à des attentes sociétales, des pouvoirs publics et des acteurs socio-économiques. Le recrutement s'effectue sur un projet de recherche et d'enseignement porté par un ou une titulaire de doctorat et s'inscrivant dans cette stratégie.

Dans ce cadre, IMT Nord Europe recrute un Enseignant Chercheur ou une Enseignante Chercheuse dont les missions sont décrites ci-après.

MISSIONS :

Sous l'autorité de la directrice du CERI EE, le ou la titulaire du poste participera aux activités d'enseignement, de recherche et de transfert de technologie :

Activités de recherche et de transfert de technologie :

Dans le cadre général de la stratégie scientifique précédemment décrite, les recherches auront pour objectif de développer des connaissances scientifiques et des outils avec pour finalité l'amélioration de la qualité de l'air des environnements intérieurs (en particulier mais de manière non exclusive dans les bâtiments), de la santé, du confort et de l'exposition des occupants tout en accompagnant les transformations du cadre bâti nécessaires à la transition écologique et énergétique.

Les thèmes de recherche attendus pourraient porter sur :

•      La préservation de la QEI face au changement climatique et à la nécessaire adaptation à ce changement ;

•      Les contributions des environnements intérieurs à l'exposition des occupants en intégrant les moyens d'évaluation et d'optimisation de l'exposition et du confort des occupants ;

•      Les impacts de la sobriété énergétique des systèmes énergétiques innovants et durables sur la QEI.

La personne recrutée devra :

•      Développer une activité de recherche de haut niveau dans le domaine de la QEI,

•      Initier, conduire et coordonner des projets de recherche régionaux, nationaux et à terme européens,

•      Développer des actions de recherche contractuelle et de transfert de technologie en partenariat avec des acteurs du monde socio-économique,

•      Créer des passerelles entre les axes thématiques du CERI EE et les autres CERI en lien avec les domaines d'excellence d'IMT Nord Europe et de l'Institut Mines Télécom,

•      Encadrer des doctorants, des post-doctorants et des étudiants de Master,

•      Préparer une Habilitation à Diriger des Recherches,

•      Participer au rayonnement de la thématique en lien étroit avec les autres collègues du CERI, notamment à l'international,

•      Publier dans les conférences et revues de référence du domaine, et participer à l'organisation d'événements scientifiques.

Activités d'enseignement :

Le CERI EE intervient dans l'ensemble des cursus Ingénieur. Il porte notamment deux des huit parcours de spécialité de l'école : GE (Génie Energétique) et GERI (Génie de l'Environnement et Risques Industriels) en formation initiale et une formation en apprentissage en Génie Energétique. Le CERI EE est également porteur de deux Mastères Spécialisés (MS) : le MS Bâtiment à Energie Positive, et le MS en Management des Risques Professionnels et Technologiques. Le CERI EE assure également des activités d'enseignements en formation continue, notamment en lien avec la QEI. Enfin, le CERI EE a pour projet de développer à court terme un projet de Master International « Engineering of Sustainable and Healthy Built Environment » dans lequel la personne recrutée viendra en appui aux personnes en charge du développement de cette formation.

La personne recrutée devra :

•      En lien avec le montage en cours d'un Master International Engineering of Sustainable and Healthy Built Environment, proposer un projet d'enseignement qui viendra, en partie, en appui des pilotes de ce Master pour notamment :

–     Contribuer à la finalisation pédagogique et à la promotion de cette nouvelle formation,

–     Contribuer aux enseignements et tutorats des étudiants du master. En s'appuyant sur l'alliance européenne EuLiST, ce Master vise à aligner activités de recherche et d'enseignement. Ces enseignements devront être dispensés en anglais.

•      Contribuer aux activités d'enseignement dans les différentes formations proposées à l'Ecole, dans son domaine de spécialité (QEI) et dans des domaines connexes (ex : chimie, thermodynamique, ...) en fonction de son champ disciplinaire ;

•      Contribuer aux activités pédagogiques sur l'ensemble des formations portées par IMT Nord Europe, en fonction de ses domaines d'expertise et des besoins pédagogiques ;

•      Contribuer à la mise en place d'innovations pédagogiques intégrant les outils numériques (MOOC, classe inversée, etc.),

•      S'investir dans les activités d'encadrement pédagogique (projets, stages, tutorats) et de sélection (concours).


PROFIL : (Prérequis/ Diplôme)

La personne retenue devra être titulaire d'un doctorat et justifier d'une expérience de recherche dans le domaine de la Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs ou dans une discipline contribuant à son étude, telle que la physico-chimie de l'air intérieur, l'évaluation de l'exposition individuelle, ou encore la performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments. Le profil recherché repose avant tout sur de solides compétences expérimentales, complété par une bonne compréhension des enjeux et des outils de simulation de la qualité de l'air intérieur. Ainsi, une aptitude à développer des recherches aux interfaces disciplinaires est recherchée afin d'articuler les problématiques d'exposition et de confort des occupants avec les caractéristiques des bâtiments et les stratégies d'amélioration de leur performance énergétique.

Il est attendu du candidat ou de la candidate de :

•      Démontrer une capacité à appréhender les enjeux multidisciplinaires liés à la QEI, avec une ouverture scientifique permettant d'intégrer des problématiques variées et de travailler aux interfaces disciplinaires ;

•      Faire preuve d'une aptitude à développer de nouvelles compétences dans des champs disciplinaires complémentaires à son profil initial ;

•      Posséder une bonne compréhension des enjeux industriels et sociétaux liés aux thématiques du poste ;

•      Attester d'une activité scientifique de qualité, traduite par des publications dans des revues et conférences à fort impact, idéalement en collaboration avec des équipes internationales ;

•      Présenter, si possible, une expérience dans le montage et la conduite de projets financés sur appels à projets compétitifs, avec obtention de financements externes ou démontrer une aptitude à coordonner des actions collectives ;

•      Montrer une appétence pour la transmission des connaissances et l'enseignement en démontrant si possible une expérience en termes d'innovations pédagogiques (MOOC, enseignement hybride, méthodes actives) ;

•      Faire preuve de compétences organisationnelles et relationnelles de manière à interagir efficacement avec l'ensemble des interlocuteurs (enseignement, recherche, support technique et autres partenaires industriels notamment) ;

•      Faire preuve d'autonomie, d'initiative, d'esprit collectif et d'un sens affirmé du service public ;

•      Disposer de solides compétences en communication scientifique et en vulgarisation, en français comme en anglais.

Une expérience internationale, une participation à des projets collaboratifs ainsi qu'un premier réseau au sein des communautés académiques et/ou industrielles constitueront des atouts appréciés. La préparation de l'HDR s'inscrira dans la perspective de l'évolution de carrière de la personne recrutée.

La résidence administrative est fixée à Douai. Des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir sur l'ensemble des implantations de l'école notamment pour l'enseignement mais aussi de manière plus générale au national et à l'international dans le cadre des activités de recherche.

Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature :

Pour des informations complémentaires sur les missions, merci de contacter :

•      Nadine LOCOGE, Directrice du CERI EE,

•      Alexandre TOMAS, Adjoint à la Directrice en charge de l'Enseignement,

•      Serge RUSSEIL, Adjoint à la Directrice en charge de la Recherche,

Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines : (Merci de ne pas transmettre votre candidature par e-mail. Seules les candidatures déposées via notre plateforme Recruitee seront prises en compte. Les dossiers envoyés par d'autres moyens, y compris à l'adresse ----- ne pourront être traités conformément à notre politique de protection des données.)

Par ailleurs, le poste peut être aménagé pour une personne en situation de handicap.

Informations à usage interne à destination des personnels sur Cadre de Gestion de l'IMT :

INFORMATIONS SUR L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL A IMT NORD EUROPE

DOSSIER DE CANDIDATURE :

Staff Product Manager, Agentic & AI Platform

About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the AI platform every Photoroom product is built on. Our mission is that any team ships best-in-class GenAI visuals without needing a backend engineer: the primitives, the gateway and the no-code tooling turn adding an AI capability into a configuration step rather than an engineering project. On top of that sits the agentic layer — multi-step visual workflows that generate, check, reason, route and publish on their own. Working closely with engineers, ML researchers, and the product teams who ship on your platform, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships.

Location: Paris, (Hybrid)

About the role

  • Own the platform every AI feature runs through. Expand and improve our AI gateway, including safeguards, evals, cost and observability, giving teams the ability to ship with little to no code and build skills that we can ship directly to users.

  • Build the agentic layer and Photoroom’s MCP. Visual agents that run multi-step flows: generate, QA, route, retry, publish, all unattended and at catalog scale.

  • Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the problem, then partner with engineering and research to ship work that feels effortless — for the developers and PMs using the platform as much as for end users.

  • Treat other teams as your customers. Every team's roadmap contains AI features gated on platform work. You'll prioritise across them, hold a strategy rather than a request queue, and say no with reasons.

  • Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue, and turn them into primitives other teams can reuse.

  • Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, such as adoption, latency, inference cost per successful generation, eval results. Form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

About You

  • You've shipped products users love. 10+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you have solved a user’s problem and delivered business outcomes.

  • You've built platform, infrastructure or developer-facing products. APIs, SDKs, internal platforms, ML infrastructure — products whose users are engineers.

  • You've shipped something agentic or model-backed into production. You understand evals, guardrails, non-deterministic output, cost per call, and what breaks when a multi-step flow runs unattended a million times.

  • AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

  • You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now. On a platform, taste shows up in the interface you make other people build against.

  • You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

  • You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

  • You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

Benefits

  • 25 days + 8–10 RTT

  • Competitive equity package with stock options/BSPCE, giving you ownership in our growing company

  • €1000 one-time home office grant OR €400 per month co-working space stipend

  • €1,000 annual learning and development budget for training, courses, books, and skill development

  • Private health insurance

  • Access to personalised mental health support, including 1:1 sessions with therapists or coaches, self-care tools, and well-being resources via MokaCare

  • Sports and cultural activities reimbursement

  • Relocation support (up to 10k) available for those choosing to move to France, including apartment finding and visa assistance

Note: Visa sponsorship and relocation support are only available for positions based in France.

Hiring Process

  1. Screening call with Talent Manager (30min)

  2. Technical interview with Hiring Manager (60min)

  3. Take-home assignment (duration varies by role) and live review with the team (90min)

  4. Culture fit interviews and meet the team (~3h in total)

  5. Reference check and offer

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Head of Financial Controller

🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

As Head of Financial Controller, you will own the full accounting function across Filigran's entities, including revenue recognition, consolidation, monthly and year-end close, and internal controls. You will act as the finance function's technical backbone building the infrastructure, controls, and processes needed to support a fast-scaling, multi-entity, international organization.

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution.

💼 Your Responsibilities

General Accounting Operations

  • Own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial transactions across Filigran entities

  • Continuously improve a scalable monthly/quarterly close process

  • Ensure revenue recognition is correctly applied and documented

Multi-Entity Oversight

  • Lead consolidation across Filigran's growing international entity structure (including new entity set-ups as the company expands)

  • Partner with the VP of Finance on transfer pricing, inter company transactions, and cross-border compliance matters

Controls, Risk & Governance

  • Perform ongoing gap analyses of accounting processes and proactively design and implement internal controls and policies

  • Manage the yearly financial audit end-to-end, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors

  • Own the relationship with the external accounting firm, holding them to a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness

Systems & Scalability

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting workflows

  • Build documentation that make the accounting function auditable and transferable

Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

  • Act as a thought partner to the VP of Finance on technical accounting matters and process design

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer (Tooling)
jobs.description:
Electrical Engineer (Tooling)

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. jobs.description:
Principal Product Designer

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets runs one of the world’s most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We’re a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting - from sports to political markets, to delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds.

At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth.

If you’re ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong.

About The Role

We're hiring a Principal Product Designer to join Smarkets. It's a role with real weight and real freedom behind it: you'll help set the Smarkets products direction and build their core experience from the ground up.

Roadmaps don't get handed down here, and specs don't arrive carved in stone. We want someone who's at their best in open, undefined territory — a designer who treats a blank space as an invitation rather than a void to be feared, and who brings structure, insight and a sense of craft to genuinely hard problems.

You'll work hand in hand with the leadership, product, and engineering teams, owning design end to end: getting to know our users, shaping the narratives the product tells, and shipping precise, carefully considered interfaces.

What you will do:

  • Design autonomously. You’ll define and drive design work from scratch - identifying what needs to be done while raising the quality bar. You’ll be working closely with execs, product, engineering.

  • Simple interfaces. Designing products that solve problems in a simple and elegant way while taking care of every small detail, from wire-framing to designing end-to-end flows and prototypes

  • Design for clarity and depth. Our product touches prediction and betting markets across many categories e.g. sports, politics, current events, technology etc. Your job is to make these powerful tools feel accessible, intuitive, and engaging.

  • Prototype quickly and test ideas. You’ll use tools like Figma, Cursor, and light code to explore concepts, validate assumptions, and refine interfaces based on real feedback.

  • Develop insights through research. You’ll talk to users, analyse behaviour, and extract meaningful patterns that inform product direction.Running guerrilla and customer testing workshops

  • Enhance our design system for both of our products. You’ll redefine the standards and systems that keep our products cohesive as they grow.

  • Act as a force-multiplier. You’ll raise the bar - not just through your own work, but by modeling great thinking, process, and collaboration across the company.

About You

  • 6+ years designing consumer products, ideally at early-stage companies.

  • A portfolio demonstrating systemic thinking and attention to detail.

  • Expertise in iOS, Android, and web design.

  • Strong visual/interaction skills and fluency in Figma and AI-coding tools (Cursor, v0, etc.).

  • Clear, thoughtful communication — whether you’re sharing work, making a case, or putting together a presentation

  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to navigate ambiguity.

  • Strategic product thinking and the ability to articulate design logic.

  • Understanding of the technical implications of your design choices.

  • A focus on UX and an understanding of human behaviour

  • Clean visual aesthetic with a mastery of typography and grids.

  • Skills in typography and grids

  • Passion for complex problem-solving.

  • Bonus: Experience in fintech, crypto, or data-intensive products.

  • Bonus: Formal design education.

 

Our Values

Our values are at the heart of everything we do - guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

  • Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

  • Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

  • Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

  • Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

  • Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn’t you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

 

Perks & Benefits
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious - united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth,and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally.

These include:

  • Stock Options: Vest over 4 years - your success is our success.

  • Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life’s most important moments.

  • Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks — because great work starts with great food.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active.

  • Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training.

  • Holiday: 25 days paid leave + bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days.

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle.

  • Team Energy: Regular socials, hackathons, and events — because collaboration and fun go hand-in-hand.

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer and celebrate diversity in all its forms. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to accommodate your needs.

jobs.title: Data Center Technician (all genders)
jobs.description:
Data Center Technician (all genders)
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible.
 

Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep.
That's your world.
As a Data Center Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer: 

  • great freedom for your creative ideas.
  • ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment.
  • Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design.
  • support with your relocation
  • a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side.
  • 30-day vacation by default.
  • an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day.
  • attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program.
  • unforgettable moments at our company events and team events.


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by phone +49 89 2441067714.

Embedded Electrical Engineer - SoM

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As an Embedded Electrical Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to design the compute modules and associated boards used across our platforms. You will own these designs end-to-end, from system architecture and schematic through layout guidance, fabrication, bring-up, and qualification. This is a high-impact role that combines demanding high-speed design work with hands-on bench work, taking hardware from a first prototype through to boards that fly.

 

Responsibilities

  • Board Design: Design SoMs, baseboards, and test boards for our compute platforms.

  • High-Speed Digital Design: Design around high-end application processors, covering PCIe, 10 Gb Ethernet, USB 3.x, and MIPI, managing layout constraints and signal integrity.

  • Power Design: Design power trees, sequencing, and conversion topologies, and verify power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Design Reviews: Prepare and lead design reviews at each milestone, from block diagram to release for fabrication.

  • Manufacture: Work with PCB and EMS partners on stack-up, via technology, layout guidance, and cost trade-offs.

  • Bring Up and Qualification: Define verification test plans, troubleshoot and characterise boards, and run thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with the embedded software team through board bring-up, the mechanical team on form factor and thermal constraints, and validation for flight qualification.

Candidate requirements

  • Educational Background: MSc in electrical, computer, or a related engineering field. A PhD is a plus. A hands-on design and bring-up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded hardware design, with boards taken from specification through bring-up and qualification into production.

  • Technical Expertise: High-speed design including layout constraints, signal integrity, and validation. Systems built around a processor with external memory (DDR, Flash) are carried through to a committed layout. Power trees with deliberate conversion topologies and verified power-up and power-down behaviour.

  • Tools: In-depth knowledge of electronic CAD tools (e.g., Altium).

  • Testing Proficiency: Proficiency with electronic test equipment and experience planning thermal, vibration, EMC, and ESD qualification.

  • Manufacturing: Experience working with fabrication and assembly partners on stack-up, via technology, and cost trade-offs.

  • Problem Solving: Rigorous, structured, and analytical; able to work autonomously and see a board from concept through to production.

  • Communication and Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to present design and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: FPGA or MPSoC design, prior work deploying AI inference on embedded targets, and UAS, drone, or defence hardware experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Senior Scientist, Upstream Fermentation R&D

Role summary:

We’re hiring a Senior Scientist, Upstream Fermentation R&D to build out Differential’s wet lab capabilities and help deliver customer projects in various domains, ranging from Probiotics to Specialty Chemicals.

You will design and run media and cultivation experiments, develop assays, and generate AI-ready datasets to drive data-driven optimizations across a range of industrially relevant microbes and applications.

You’ll work closely with our existing microbiology team, help scale it further, and coach junior team members on experimental execution, documentation standards, and reproducibility.

You share our vision and actively evangelize data/AI/robotics-driven media and bioprocess optimization as the engine of the Bioeconomy’s Future.

If this is you, apply and tell us how you’ll put it into practice.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead cultivation and study of a broad range of microbial species, from our current focus on lactic acid bacteria to industry workhorses such as E. coli, P. pastoris, and B. subtilis; also handle strains with challenging traits.

  • Develop media to enhance productivity and stability at lab scale, with the potential (not required) to extend into bioprocess development (e.g., feeding strategies, temperature, pH) at lab and production scale.

  • Design, validate, and standardize assays that inform media/bioprocess choices and support strain characterization, functional testing, and QC.

  • Translate customer requirements into lean, milestone-driven scientific research plans that optimize speed, cost, and decision quality in a resource-conscious startup environment.

  • Collaborate with lab automation and data science teams to design scalable, model-ready data capture for fermentation parameters and metabolite panels.

  • Lead and develop junior scientists/technicians to execute experiments precisely and maintain rigorous documentation, enforcing SOP/QA standards.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. (or equivalent work experience) in Microbiology or related field

  • 3+ years in industrial or translational research in microbial fermentation (probiotics/(agri)food/cosmetics preferred).

  • Proven ownership and hands-on experience in cultivation and media development across lactid acid bacteria, B. subtilis, E. coli, and yeasts in an industrial/bioprocess setting; exposure to challenging traits (fastidious, anaerobic) is a plus. Strong depth in at least one is sufficient.

  • Assay developer at heart with demonstrated design/validation of microbiology assays.

  • Demonstrated ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, resource-constrained research environment, proven judgment on time/budget trade-offs (build vs. buy, lab infrastructure, lean experimentation) to optimize speed, cost, and decision quality.

Nice-to-have:

  • Hands-on experience with benchtop bioreactors; huge plus if you have demonstrated scale-up experience, from lab to production-scale.

  • Experience with obligate anaerobes and otherwise challenging strains, e.g. handling fastidious, flocculent, agglutinating, sporulating strains, and working with nutritionally demanding or slow-growing microbes.

  • Proven cross-functional project management across wetlab and automation/bioinformatics/bioprocess workstreams.

  • Experience with Python/R/Matlab for DoE, growth/fermentation analytics, modeling-ready datasets, and light scripting; reads/writes instrument CSV/API and LIMS fields.

  • Having already demonstrated a builder mindset, experience shipping in a startup or through internal research projects; comfortable with ambiguity and end-to-end ownership.

We are looking for a Propulsion Test Engineer to plan, prepare, execute, and analyse in-house propulsion tests. You will focus on static-fire testing of small, medium, and large rocket motors, working with propulsion engineers and the wider team to produce safe, repeatable tests and high-quality data that drives the next design iteration.

We run hot fire tests and launch campaigns regularly, as such this is a unique opportunity to be in the heart of the action.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Define test objectives, success criteria, instrumentation requirements, test configurations, and data products.

  • Prepare test procedures, checklists, risk controls, readiness reviews, and supporting documentation.

  • Prepare motors, fixtures, sensors, data-acquisition systems, facilities, and support equipment for testing.

  • Execute or support static-fire tests safely and methodically, troubleshooting issues as they arise.

  • Acquire, validate, reduce, and analyse data such as force, pressure, and temperature measurements.

  • Produce post-test reports and work with engineers to feed results into design, formulation, and test-process improvements.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in mechanical, aerospace, electrical, or systems engineering, physics, mechatronics, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

  • Experience in test engineering, experimental engineering, laboratory testing, commissioning, or another hands-on hardware environment.

  • Experience developing or executing test procedures and working systematically through preparation, execution, data review, and reporting.

  • Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, data acquisition, calibration, and signal quality.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to safety, and a methodical approach under pressure.

  • Willingness to work directly with test stands, fixtures, cabling, instrumentation, hardware, and facilities.

Desirable experience

  • Static-fire testing or testing rocket engines, solid or hybrid motors, combustion hardware, pressure systems, or other hazardous aerospace hardware.

  • Thrust stands, pressure transducers, load cells, thermocouples, or high-speed data acquisition.

  • Test automation, Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar engineering tools.

  • Test-data reduction, uncertainty analysis, signal processing, anomaly detection, or correlation against simulation.

  • Test-facility operations, hazardous-materials controls, explosives safety, or formal test-readiness processes.

  • Propulsion fundamentals, thermodynamics, combustion, fluid mechanics, or internal ballistics.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

What you will do

  • Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

  • Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools.

  • Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs.

  • Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation.

  • Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations.

  • Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior.

  • Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation.

About you

  • You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows.

  • You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field.

  • You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics.

  • You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability.

  • You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition.

  • You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation.

  • You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans.

  • You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders.

It would be great if you

  • Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems.

  • Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows.

  • Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers.

  • Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities.

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. That means distributed state under unreliable networks, dense telemetry moving fast enough to strain anything you've built before, and interfaces for a problem space that barely has prior art. You'll work across the stack, wherever the hard problem is that week.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and ship features in the C2 system that directs swarms of heterogeneous aircraft

WHAT SETS YOU APART

You'll be one of the earliest engineers shaping how humans command autonomous systems at scale, work that's currently being defined in real time, by a small team, with your fingerprints on the architecture. Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We’re building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you’ll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What you'll do

  • Make content

    Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

  • Build demos and tutorials

    Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

  • Represent Supabase

    Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You’ll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

  • Support and grow the community

    Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

  • Collaborate across the company

    Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You might be a fit if:

  • You’ve built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

  • You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

  • You’re equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

  • You’re energized by community whether it’s on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

  • You’re self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in San Francisco to support regular in-person devrel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the SF tech ecosystem.

  • Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

  • Experience creating technical content (written or video)

  • Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

Bonus points if you have:

  • A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

  • Prior experience in DevRel or open source

  • Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Rankings & Recommendations (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist - Rankings & Recommendations (all genders)

Your future team

You'll join Search Intelligence, the team behind Holidu's ranking and recommendation systems. With over 8 million vacation rental properties on the platform, your models will determine which of them our 70+ million annual users discover first — directly shaping search conversion and business results. It's one of the highest-leverage problems in the company — and we're not just maintaining a finished system: we're pushing the boundaries of what search at Holidu can do. You'll work with a large and rich dataset, fast paths from concept to production, and the autonomy to act on your own judgment.

Holidu is an AI-first company, and it shows in how we work: your modelling stays grounded in machine learning and statistics, but you'll have large-scale access to the best AI tools and the freedom to weave them into everything you do — from discovery to implementation to maintenance. Everyone here experiments and shares what works, and we'll count on you to help push how far AI can take us.

This role is based in Munich with two office days/week.

The ranking challenge at Holidu

Ranking at Holidu is already a deep system: a multi-stage pipeline with reinforcement-learning-based cold ranking, contextual re-ranking, and personalized recommendations, plus dedicated cold-start models for new properties with limited behavioral data. And it keeps expanding — we're starting to enrich our models with AI-generated semantic signals that describe what makes each home special, opening the door to smarter ranking and entirely new search experiences.The next generation of it is yours to figure out.

Some of the hard challenges we're tackling: balancing user relevance, conversion probability, and business value in a single ranking. Personalizing for users who are mostly anonymous or first-time visitors. Surfacing great new properties before any behavioral data exists — when a significant share of our inventory is new each quarter. And adapting our ranking to evolving partner and business models, where the right answer changes as the marketplace does.

Our Tech Stack

Python • Airflow • dbt • AWS (SageMaker, Redshift, Athena) • MLflow

 

Your role in this journey

You'll shape the ranking and recommendation systems that millions of guests rely on end-to-end. You will:

  • Develop high-impact models and improvements for our ranking, recommendation, and personalization systems — with the freedom to explore new, creative approaches.

  • Take models from conception to production, monitor their performance, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency.

  • Design and run A/B tests as a core part of ranking development — ship experiments fast, learn from real traffic, and let winning ideas go live.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Software Engineers to identify, prioritize, and ship ranking improvements.

  • Ensure model reliability in production — online/offline agreement, drift KPIs, latency and uptime SLAs, and automated monitoring.

  • Take the technical lead on projects by driving direction, scoping initiatives, and guiding prioritization.

  • Continuously fold AI into how you work — finding smarter, faster ways to build, experiment on, and maintain your systems and workflows.

Your backpack is filled with

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist with a proven track record of applying ML models to solve real business problems.

  • Experience with ranking models or recommender systems is a strong advantage.

  • A quantitative degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field.

  • Strong foundations in statistics, predictive modelling, and machine learning, with hands-on experience in Python and SQL.

  • Hands-on experience with tree-based and gradient-boosting models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) on large-scale tabular data.

  • A proactive, self-starting mindset — you love to own a domain and shape it end-to-end.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for using AI in your daily work — you experiment, adopt what works, and help move the boundaries of its usage.

Our adventure includes

  • Impact: Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters - and you’ll see the impact.

  • Learning: Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets - with a strong focus on AI.

  • Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts - people we can all relate to - making work meaningful and energizing.

  • Technology: Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.

  • Flexibility: Work a hybrid setup with 50% in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.

  • Perks on Top: Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized - but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

Need a sneak peek?
Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram @lifeatholidu and dive straight into the world of Tech at Holidu for more insights!

Want to travel with us?

Apply online on our careers page! Your first travel contact will be Adam from HR.

We are committed to diversity in all aspects of our business. We encourage applications from all genders, all corners of the world and all individual backgrounds. You are welcome to submit your application without a photo and without stating your gender, date of birth, marital status, nationality or disability status (if applicable). If you require any special assistance when arranging interviews, office visits or the recruitment process in general, please contact the relevant HR person responsible for this job and we will do our best to accommodate your needs.
