Data Scientist, Risk

Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Role Summary

The Risk team at Imprint is responsible for making smarter, faster credit decisions that balance growth with responsible risk management. The team builds the models, policies, and analytical systems that power underwriting, fraud detection, and portfolio optimization across all of Imprint’s credit programs.

As a Data Scientist, Risk, you will own the modeling powering Imprint’s top-of-funnel credit decisioning—from application intake through approval—across every acquisition channel: direct affiliates (Credit Karma, NerdWallet), invitation-to-apply emails, direct mail, paid social, instant prescreens, and on-site applications. Your primary focus will be improving approval rates while maintaining credit quality: building better underwriting models, designing policy experiments, and uncovering segments where we can safely expand access to credit.

This role sits at the intersection of credit and acquisition strategy. You will partner directly with Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to build targeting models for new channels, evaluate channel-level credit performance, and connect acquisition volume to downstream economics—approval rates, vintage loss forecasts, LTV, CAC, and contribution profit. Increasingly, that means building not just analyses but AI-powered systems that can autonomously monitor approval rate, channel performance, diagnose shifts, and recommend policy adjustments.

The Opportunity

  • Own and improve the full top-of-funnel credit decisioning pipeline: application scoring, policy rules, decline waterfalls, and approval rate optimization across direct affiliates, invitation-to-apply, direct mail, paid social, instant prescreens, and on-site applications

  • Build and iterate on underwriting, targeting, and segmentation models that expand safe approvals and improve channel-level acquisition quality

  • Design and analyze A/B tests and champion/challenger experiments on credit policies, establishing a test-and-learn cadence with structured readouts on both acquisition and credit performance

  • Build channel-level performance models that connect application volume to downstream economics: approval rates, expected losses, LTV, CAC, and contribution profit

  • Design and build agentic workflows and AI-powered monitoring systems that autonomously detect approval rate anomalies, diagnose score drift and population mix changes, and recommend policy adjustments

  • Partner directly with Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to develop targeting criteria and risk frameworks for new and emerging acquisition channels

  • Build segmentation frameworks to identify underserved populations where credit access can be responsibly expanded

Your Profile

Required

  • 5 to 8+ years of experience in data science, risk analytics, or a related quantitative field, ideally at a high-growth startup or fintech company

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with the ability to build models, transform raw data, and create custom datasets from complex financial data

  • Experience building credit risk or targeting models (scorecards, underwriting models, segmentation) or similar predictive modeling in a regulated environment

  • Deep understanding of statistical inference, experimentation design, and causal analysis, with the ability to disentangle policy impact from population shifts and channel mix changes

  • Comfort with AI tools and AI-native workflows; you actively use tools like Claude, Copilot, or similar to accelerate your work and are excited to build AI-powered analytical systems

  • Full-stack problem-solving orientation: you dive into messy data, trace a decline to its root cause, and question assumptions in pursuit of a better answer

  • Ability to present complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and external partner stakeholders

  • Comfort owning projects end-to-end in a fast-moving startup environment with limited scaffolding, collaborating cross-functionally with Policy, Strategy, Product, and Engineering

Nice to Have

  • Experience with credit card underwriting, lending, or consumer credit products

  • Familiarity with credit bureau data (Vantage, FICO, tradeline attributes) and alternative data sources

  • Experience building or scaling experimentation infrastructure for credit policy testing

  • Exposure to fraud detection, KYC/IDV workflows, or application fraud models

  • Understanding of acquisition channel economics and experience partnering with marketing or credit strategy teams on targeting and LTV modeling

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring strong fundamentals, we encourage you to apply.

Stack

Python and SQL for modeling and analysis. Snowflake for data warehousing. AWS infrastructure. Dashboarding and monitoring tools for production systems.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog: https://medium.com/imprint-eng

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer

NetDocuments is committed to providing an excellent candidate experience and will never ask you to engage in recruitment activity without phone, video, and in person meetings and communications from emails using the @netdocuments.com domain. If you have any concerns or questions about communications you have received, please send them to hrgroup@netdocuments.com so our team members can review.

About NetDocuments

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

  • Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
  • Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace
  • Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

NetDocuments is seeking a Principal Software Engineer – Intelligent DMS to provide technical leadership across the next generation of our document management platform. This role will help shape the architecture connecting our new web and mobile experiences, design system, extended applications, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered capabilities into a cohesive platform. You’ll operate as a deeply hands-on technical leader, spending the majority of your time solving complex engineering problems while driving architectural decisions that span multiple teams and products. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, platform engineering, and our AI teams to establish scalable patterns, simplify complex systems, and ensure the experiences we build meet the reliability, security, performance, and usability standards expected by the world’s leading legal organizations.

You will:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Provide technical leadership across the Intelligent DMS organization, establishing architectural direction and engineering standards that span multiple teams and product surfaces.
  • Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend services, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered experiences.
  • Define shared technical patterns, component contracts, data models, permission models, and integration approaches that create a cohesive platform.
  • Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from early product ideation through architecture, implementation, and production.
  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs across scalability, security, performance, usability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
  • Simplify complex systems and establish technical foundations that enable teams to move faster as the platform evolves.

Design & Build

  • Contribute directly to the most complex and consequential areas of the Intelligent DMS platform.
  • Design and build cloud-native applications, microservices, integrations, and customer-facing experiences at enterprise scale.
  • Help architect the next-generation web and mobile applications and the backend services that support them.
  • Establish patterns for integrating AI capabilities such as assistants, summarization, extraction, and intelligent search into everyday document workflows.
  • Lead technical design for Microsoft 365 experiences, including co-authoring and integrations across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Design solutions that maintain correctness, security, and matter-levl permissions across highly concurrent and distributed workflows.

Platform Evolution & Modernization

  • Define technical strategies for evolving mature applications and integrations onto the next-generation platform without disrupting critical customer workflows.
  • Establish migration patterns that allow legacy and next-generation experiences to operate effectively during platform transitions.
  • Drive technical coherence across extended applications, desktop clients, sync, import, browser extensions, mobile applications, and Microsoft 365 integrations.
  • Partner with platform and AI engineering teams to establish scalable integration patterns for shared services and capabilities.
  • Set performance and reliability standards for customer-facing applications and drive systemic improvements required to meet them.

Cross-Team Technical Leadership

  • Lead technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams without relying on formal reporting authority.
  • Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Platform, and AI teams around architectural direction and implementation strategy.
  • Translate ambiguous product opportunities into clear technical requirements, architecture, and executable plans.
  • Document architectural decisions and ensure teams understand the reasoning, trade-offs, and standards behind them.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point when teams encounter complex architectural or engineering challenges.

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

  • Mentor engineers across experience levels, including Senior and Staff Engineers, and provide guidance on architecture, system design, and engineering practices.
  • Drive testing, quality, security, and reliability strategies across the Intelligent DMS organization.
  • Establish and maintain architecture documentation, engineering standards, and technical patterns that scale beyond individual projects.
  • Lead design and code reviews for complex or high-impact initiatives.
  • Partner with other Principal Engineers and our Chief Architect to advance technical excellence across the broader engineering organization.
  • Support recruiting and interviewing efforts to help build a high-performing engineering team.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

  • Stay current with advancements in AI-native product development, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and modern software engineering.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve customer experience or engineering effectiveness.
  • Validate new technical approaches with real users and production feedback before scaling them broadly.
  • Champion engineering practices that prioritize simplicity, measurable customer value, and sustainable technical foundations.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience operating at the Staff level or above.
  • Proven experience setting architecture and technical direction across multiple products, systems, or engineering teams.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-team technical initiatives without formal authority and driving alignment across engineering stakeholders.
  • Deep expertise in system design, distributed systems, cloud applications, microservices, and enterprise-scale integrations.
  • Strong full stack engineering experience with the ability to work across frontend and backend systems; our technology stack includes C#, .NET, React, and TypeScript.
  • Experience designing and operating cloud-native systems using AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud technologies.
  • Experience translating ambiguous product requirements into clear technical architecture and implementation plans.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers and providing technical guidance across teams.
  • Strong technical writing skills with experience creating architecture documents, design proposals, and technical decision records.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience shipping AI-native product experiences where AI is fundamental to the product workflow.
  • Experience operating multi-tenant enterprise platforms with strict security, compliance, or data residency requirements.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office add-ins, Microsoft Graph, or co-authoring technologies.
  • Experience modernizing legacy applications while maintaining heavily used production systems and managing complex customer migrations.
  • Experience in legal technology, professional-services SaaS, or other regulated enterprise software environments.
  • Public examples of technical leadership through conference speaking, technical writing, open-source contributions, or architectural patterns adopted by other teams.
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives through both successful outcomes and lessons learned from approaches that did not work.

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments

  • The People!
  • 90% healthcare premiums company covered
  • HSA company contribution
  • 401(k) match at 4% with immediate vesting
  • Flexible PTO (typically 3 to 4 weeks a year)
  • 10 paid holidays
  • Monthly contributions for life activities & wellness
  • Access to LinkedIn Learning with monthly dedicated time to explore
  • Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders
  • Growing company with opportunities for advancement
  • Authenticity and accountability from leadership

Compensation Transparency

The compensation range for this position is $200,000 – $220,000.

The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Partner Marketing Manager

Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Partner Marketing Manager

Role Summary

As Partner Marketing Manager, you will own the full marketing strategy and growth outcomes for several of Imprint's largest co-branded credit card partnerships. You are the marketing leader for your partners: the person accountable for how we acquire, activate, and retain cardholders across every channel, and the person partners look to as the strategic marketing mind behind their program.

You will operate as the CMO for your assigned partners: leading annual marketing planning in lockstep with General Managers and partner executives, owning full-funnel performance from application through long-term retention, and driving high-impact campaign strategy and execution across paid, owned, and partner channels. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategic planning and hands-on technical execution, who earns credibility with senior partner stakeholders, and who builds marketing programs that compound in quality and impact as Imprint scales its co-branded portfolio.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Built and presented a 12-month marketing plan for each assigned partner with quarterly execution detail, investment priorities, and measurable growth targets, aligned with GMs and partner marketing leadership

  • Completed a diagnostic assessment of each partner's full-funnel performance (application through retention), identified the highest leverage opportunities, and built a prioritized optimization roadmap with clear sequencing

  • Created a partner marketing playbook defining audience segmentation, positioning, messaging architecture, and channel strategy that serves as the strategic foundation for internal creative and campaign teams and holds up in senior partner conversations

  • Launched or meaningfully iterated on campaigns in at least two channels (lifecycle, paid social, direct mail, affiliate) with measurable performance improvements and a clear point of view on what to scale next

  • Established yourself as a trusted strategic partner to GMs, Lifecycle Managers, product, engineering, marketing analytics, and partner marketing leadership

  • Demonstrated technical depth in campaign deployment tools and workflows, with the credibility to make architectural decisions about how campaigns are built and delivered

Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy and Growth Ownership

  • Own marketing strategy, planning, execution, and performance for major co-branded partners, with direct accountability for partner growth outcomes including acquisition volume, activation, spend, and retention

  • Lead the development of 12-month marketing roadmaps in partnership with GMs, including quarterly planning cycles, budget allocation, and investment tradeoff decisions

  • Present marketing strategy and performance to partner marketing leadership and internal executives, owning the growth narrative for your assigned programs

  • Identify and prioritize the highest leverage opportunities across the funnel and make investment recommendations based on performance data, partner dynamics, and competitive landscape

Acquisition and Campaign Strategy

  • Design, lead, and optimize acquisition campaigns across paid channels (paid social, paid search, affiliate, direct mail) and owned channels (lifecycle, in-app, email)

  • Develop and own experimentation frameworks that systematically improve CAC, LTV, and partner-specific KPIs, with a rigorous approach to test design, measurement, and learning

  • Build audience segmentation, positioning, and messaging strategies that sharpen creative execution, strengthen partner channel marketing, and drive measurable lift in conversion

  • Make channel mix and budget allocation decisions based on performance data, and have the judgment to shift resources quickly when the data warrants it

Full-Funnel Optimization

  • Partner with Lifecycle Managers and analytics to own full-funnel performance: application rate, approval rate, activation rate, spend behavior, insurance attach, and retention

  • Diagnose funnel breakdowns and lead cross-functional efforts to resolve them, working across product, engineering, analytics, and lifecycle to ship improvements

  • Build and maintain a clear performance story for each partner: what's working, what's not, where the leverage is, and what the plan is

Partner Relationship and Influence

  • Serve as the senior marketing point of contact for assigned partners, building trust and credibility with partner marketing leadership through strategic depth and consistent delivery

  • Translate partner objectives and commercial goals into actionable marketing strategies that create value for both Imprint and the partner

  • Bring a clear, data-informed point of view into partner conversations and the strategic credibility to shape joint marketing decisions, not just execute on partner requests

  • Set expectations with partners on what's realistic, what's working, and where we should invest next, and have the conviction to push back when needed

Vendor and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Own relationships with external vendors (affiliate platforms, direct mail bureaus, media agencies) and lead vendor performance management, negotiation, and strategic alignment

  • Drive cross-functional alignment with product, engineering, analytics, and creative to ensure marketing programs are executed with speed and quality

  • Identify gaps in marketing infrastructure, tooling, or process and lead initiatives to improve campaign deployment speed, quality, and scalability

Measurement and Reporting

  • Own the measurement framework and reporting cadence for assigned partners, tracking application volume, approval rate, activation rate, insurance attach, partner revenue, retention, and LTV

  • Lead performance reviews with internal stakeholders and partner teams, translating data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations

  • Use performance insights to continuously refine strategy, reallocate investment, and raise the bar on what good looks like across the portfolio

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 to 10+ years of growth marketing or partner marketing experience in financial services or fintech, with a track record of leading (not just supporting) the launch and scaling of products or partnerships

  • Deep technical knowledge of marketing workflows across paid and owned channels, including lifecycle campaign deployment through tools like Braze, with the ability to make architectural and workflow decisions

  • Experience with affiliate platforms (Impact, AWIN) and paid acquisition channels (paid social, paid search), with demonstrated ability to optimize channel mix and manage meaningful media budgets

  • Strong analytical skills with proven experience diagnosing funnel performance, designing experiments, and optimizing CAC, approval rates, activation rates, LTV, and retention at scale

  • Proven ability to build marketing plans, experimentation frameworks, and funnel optimization strategies in close partnership with cross-functional teams, and the leadership skills to drive alignment and accountability

  • Track record of building trust and credibility with senior partner stakeholders, with the ability to represent Imprint's marketing strategy at the executive level

  • Exceptional communicator who can translate complex partner objectives into clear marketing strategies, and who can present confidently to both internal leadership and external partner teams

Nice to Have

  • Growth marketing depth: experience leading performance media campaigns end to end with a strong command of CAC optimization, paid media strategy, and budget management across multiple channels

  • Direct mail expertise: experience deploying pre-screen direct mail or ITA campaigns, including working with data providers (TransUnion, Axiom) and direct mail vendors (DMS)

  • Experience in high-growth startups or scaling marketing programs in resource-constrained environments where you had to build the playbook while shipping at speed

  • Familiarity with product marketing for new product launches, not just management of existing programs, and comfort operating in ambiguity during early-stage go-to-market

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

jobs.description:
Account Director, Client Solutions

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Client Solutions based in United Kingdom.

As an Account Director, Client Solutions, you will own a portfolio of strategic client relationships from discovery through delivery, renewal, and expansion. You’ll serve as the senior commercial and strategic point of contact for executive stakeholders, helping clients turn customer data into measurable revenue growth. The role combines consulting, account leadership, commercial ownership, and project direction without requiring you to be the hands-on technical builder. You’ll work closely with architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scoped, delivered, and aligned with business objectives. With clients across Europe and North America, you’ll operate in a diverse environment spanning multiple industries, technologies, and regulatory contexts. This is a high-ownership opportunity for an experienced client leader who can connect strategy, technology, and commercial outcomes.


Accountabilities
  • Own the executive-level relationship across a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary strategic contact for senior marketing and growth stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain a strong client cadence through biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews covering results, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.
  • Keep clients proactively informed about progress, budgets, timelines, risks, and decisions, ensuring there are no unexpected developments.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting each challenge to the relevant customer pain, metric, business impact, and potential solution.
  • Build and defend growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients, using measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle strategies, experimentation roadmaps, and performance readouts.
  • Translate technical decisions and recommendations into clear business implications that executive stakeholders can understand and act upon.
  • Scope projects and translate client requirements into sufficiently detailed briefs for architects and engineers, while remaining accountable for the quality and business relevance of the final outcome.
  • Lead project execution through sprint cadence, board management, dependencies, risks, timelines, and critical-path oversight rather than performing the technical implementation yourself.
  • Review completed work against agreed client objectives before delivery and ensure commitments are fulfilled to the expected standard.
  • Run pre-sales discovery, qualify opportunities, develop proposals, and present scope, phasing, investment, and business cases directly to prospective clients.
  • Partner with Sales throughout qualification, discovery, and closing before taking ownership of the account during delivery.
  • Price and scope technical work with profitability and delivery feasibility in mind.
  • Own retention and expansion across your portfolio, ensuring scope changes are estimated, documented, and approved before work begins.
  • Maintain a six-month forward roadmap so future engagements can be planned and contracted before existing scopes come to an end.

    • 10+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 5 years owning senior client relationships with direct revenue responsibility.

    • Strong understanding of the full marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost between stages.

    • Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and data-driven approaches for improving marketing performance and returns.

    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive issues through to resolution.

jobs.title: Founding Sales Development Representative (DACH)
jobs.description:
Founding Sales Development Representative (DACH)

Tremendous is the fast, free, flexible way to send bulk payouts to people in over 230 countries and regions. 20,000+ companies ranging from mom-and-pops to Google, MIT, and United Way have sent over $1 billion, saving 15 hours a month on average.

In both our product and our workplace, we’re intentional about making work more efficient, flexible, and fulfilling. Tremendous is a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life.

Our customers, who include marketers, researchers, HR teams, and nonprofits, rave about how quick and easy it is to use Tremendous — check the ratings on G2. Yet there’s a lot of complexity under the hood, including over 2,500 redemption options and plenty of banking infrastructure. This duality makes working here a fun challenge.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. Join us before our next international offsite.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founding European SDR to help launch and scale Tremendous’ outbound motion internationally. As our first international SDR hire, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and booking meetings with high-potential prospects, while helping define how we sell into new European markets.

You will partner closely with Account Executives to generate meetings and act as the first point of contact for prospective customers. This role requires strong outbound execution across email, phone, social, events, and field marketing, with meaningful ownership over account development and early market strategy.

As a founding hire, you will have the opportunity to shape messaging, process, and best practices for international sales while directly impacting pipeline, revenue growth, and Tremendous’ expansion internationally.

What you'll do

  • Work primarily to bring in new deals through outbound prospecting

  • Own your pipeline through cold calling first. The phone is your primary weapon; you'll be expected to make 100 cold calls per day, book meetings over the phone, and treat every unanswered call as the next opportunity to dial again. Email and LinkedIn support your outreach; they don't replace it

  • Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing, Strategy, and RevOps teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business

  • Use prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging

  • Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What you'll bring

  • You're fluent in both English and German, enabling you to engage prospects across our DACH markets

  • You pick up the phone before you open email. Cold calling isn't something you tolerate - it's how you start your day, every day, without being told to.

  • Demonstrated history of consistently exceeding personal and professional goals, with a strong commitment to excellence in all endeavors

  • Curious, lifelong learner mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, staying updated on industry trends and best practices, and showing enthusiasm for applying newly acquired knowledge to improve job performance

  • Customer-obsessed sales approach, demonstrating a deep commitment to understanding and addressing the unique needs of our clients

  • Someone who is proficient in English and workplace proficient in at least one other language (preferably German, Spanish or French)

  • Independent. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.

  • Collaborative. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.

  • Ambitious. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

What's cool about the role

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: £45K – £52K, OTE: £65-78K

  • Fully remote.

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

jobs.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

Are you a Licensed Clinical Social Worker looking to launch a private practice, or grow your existing practice?

Headway currently supports thousands of mental health clinicians across the United States in our mission to rewire the mental healthcare system for access and affordability by equipping mental health practitioners with the tools and resources they need to run their practices.

Whether you're new to private practice or already have an established practice of your own, we’re excited to support you in reaching your goals!

By joining the Headway community, we’ll help you:

  • Accept insurance hassle-free by credentialing you with the nation’s largest networks and handling the billing and admin paperwork for you.

  • Maintain a flexible schedule by deciding how many clients you see through Headway, so that you can set the hours that work for you.

  • Grow your caseload by providing marketing support and best practices to grow your practice!

  • Use Headway’s practice management software to run your practice, but if using your own works better, that’s fine too!

We’ll also support your clients by:

  • Providing live, customized support to clinicians and clients in order to streamline the process of both seeking and providing care.

  • Verifying client insurance benefits instantly and automatically, so that access to care is never delayed, and you can see your clients with confidence.

And we do this all without additional fees! Headways is a flexible service, meaning your hours are yours to set, and it’s up to you whether you see your patients in-person or remotely via telehealth while working from home.

Ready to get started?

To join Headway’s growing community, you are/have:

  • Licensure: You’re a Masters Level Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW, LICSW, LCSCW)

  • NPI Number and Individual Malpractice Insurance: We can point you in the right direction if you don’t have those yet!

jobs.description:
Clinical Product Lead

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role

At Headway, we're building the future of behavioral health — and increasingly, that means shipping products that providers and patients rely on every day. We're hiring a Clinical Product Lead to own the clinical judgment behind how risk gets detected, escalated, and closed out across our platform, and to make sure every product surface we build is connected to the safety systems behind it.

Headway already has real safety capability through risk detection, human triage, a 24/7 crisis partner, and more. However as our platform expands, particularly into AI tooling, so does our need for a single coherent system and point of ownership for patient safety across product surfaces.

This role sits on our Clinical Product team, partnering daily with engineering, product, and clinical operations. You'll also carry the clinical safety bar for our AI surfaces.

This is a first-of-its-kind role. You'll help define what "safe" means for a behavioral health platform operating at the scale of our network — and then build the products and systems that make it true rather than aspirational.

You will:

  • Own the clinical requirements for how patient risk is detected and mitigated through our platform surfaces including the patient portal, support chat and phone, clinical assessments, conversational intake, and more. Drive us toward one shared severity taxonomy and routing model.

  • Serve as the Clinical Product Patient Safety partner for product features that carry the potential for risk disclosure. Define safety requirements and safeguards, integrate the product into existing escalations structures, and red-team the failure points. Stay with the feature after launch to review how the safeguards performed.

  • Audit our product surfaces to identify patient safety gaps. Collaborate within the clinical team and with cross functional partners to close those gaps.

  • Support us in holding the clinical safety and quality bar for our AI surfaces such as AI-generated clinical notes, treatment planning, and conversational tools. Write rubrics, label the gold-standard cases our models learn from, and audit model output against your own clinical assessment.

  • Resolve risk-ownership questions and ensure that our policies and the platform clearly and accurately reflect that position.

  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly to non-clinical stakeholders — including when speed, scale, or automation must be balanced against clinical rigor — and push back constructively when product or technical decisions conflict with sound clinical judgment.

You will love this role if:

  • You are an Independently Licensed Therapist (LPC, LCSW, PhD, or PsyD) with 3+ years of post-graduate clinical experience.

  • You have worked inside a safety or quality system and feel extremely confident in risk assessment and safety planning, and crisis response.

  • You are a systems thinker. You can look at a set of disconnected escalation paths and see the single model underneath.

  • You thrive working quickly and cross-functionally with engineers, product partners, and operations teams. You're comfortable saying "what you’re proposing carries some risk, and here's the clinical reason why," and you know how to make that feedback actionable for people who don't share your clinical training.

  • You are a first-principles thinker who can break down fuzzy clinical concepts (therapeutic alliance, medical necessity, risk assessment, patient safety) into something concrete enough to label, evaluate, and ship against.

  • You have a working understanding of how AI models are evaluated — concepts like precision, recall, and false positive rates don't intimidate you, and you can connect them to real clinical consequences (e.g., what it means for a model to miss a safety concern vs. over-flag one).

  • You are flexible and energized by ambiguity. Headway's clinical AI roadmap will shift across the next year, and you're excited to flex across quality, safety, and product AI projects as our needs evolve.

  • You are motivated by the opportunity to improve access to high-quality behavioral healthcare at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, RC Capital
jobs.description:
Senior Data Scientist, RC Capital

RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $10B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We’re a remote‑first crew of 120+, spread across 25 countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in.

The Role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to support product initiatives for RevenueCat Capital, with deep experience in lead qualification, anomaly detection, fraud prevention, and underwriting.

This is a chance to be the founding Data Scientist embedded within the Capital team, a greenfield opportunity to scale our new fintech business lines from <$1M to $100M+.

You'll partner directly with leadership, collaborate across teams, and bring a new product to life inside RevenueCat. Your work will touch real money, real developers, and a product that is just getting started. Read more about the opportunity here.

The Opportunity: RC Capital

RevenueCat is on a mission to help developers make more money. We build software that helps apps implement and manage purchases, with over 50% of new subscription apps on the App Store launching with RevenueCat. OpenAI's mobile subscriptions run on RC. Top of funnel metrics are up 300%+ YoY.

RC Capital is our next chapter: we'll continue to help developers make more money, not just through software, but through financial products. Financial institutions would love to have what we already have:

  • Trust + distribution: App developers already trust us in their purchase flow — the highest stakes moment in any user journey.

  • Real-time, verifiable data: Cross-platform revenue plus leading indicators like installs, trials, conversions, and refunds.

  • Unmatched industry insights: We know how apps earn money at scale, which improves underwriting and product design.

Our first product is Daily Payouts: a factoring product that lets developers get app store proceeds sooner. Scaling it is a big challenge, but it’s just the beginning. There’s so much more to build: credit cards, revenue-based lending, cohort-based financing. We’ve got a mountain to climb.

What you'll do

  • Own the Data Science strategy for RC Capital. Build the foundation for our underwriting and fraud detection systems from the ground up. Nothing is locked in, you'll define the models, the signals, and the approach.

  • Develop sophisticated models for lead qualification, anomaly detection, fraud prevention, and credit underwriting. All this using the richest, most real-time app revenue data in the world.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to integrate risk signals and underwriting logic into customer-facing flows and internal decisioning engines.

  • Analyze cross-platform revenue data to uncover insights that improve our underwriting models and product design.

  • Build mechanisms for measuring impact, evaluating model performance, and driving prioritization of new data initiatives.

  • Operate with high ownership in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment helping to define the long-term vision for our financial products.

About you

You are a Senior Data Scientist who cares deeply about impact and has direct experience with the kind of models that carry real financial consequence. From a skills perspective, you bring:

  • You have 5+ years of data science experience, ideally with a strong background in fintech, credit, lending, or payments.

  • You have deep expertise in fraud and/or underwriting. You know how to build models that balance risk and growth, and you understand the nuances of financial data.

  • You're highly analytical and technical. You are an expert in SQL and Python. You can build, deploy, and monitor models in production. You don't wait for someone else to pull the data.

  • You understand mobile apps or developer ecosystems, or you're eager to learn this space and how apps earn money at scale.

  • You act like an owner. You aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves and get something done yourself. You treat RevenueCat's balance sheet, product, and brand like it's your own.

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable making low-information, high-stakes decisions. You can quickly get to confidence, move on, and iterate.

  • You're a systems thinker. You can step back from the particular and see the process. You look for opportunities to automate and build things that scale, when you've had enough signal to know that you should.

  • You know when it's good enough. You are obsessed with getting things right, but you know when you're at diminishing returns. You balance detail, speed, and ambition without losing sight of impact.

What success look like

In the first month, you'll:

  • Understand how Daily Payouts works today and what data powers it.

  • Get to know the team and the current state of our underwriting and fraud approach.

  • Form your own point of view on where the biggest gaps are.

Within the first 3 months, you'll:

  • Have a baseline fraud detection model in production. Imperfect is fine, measurable is required.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to integrate risk signals into real customer flows.

  • Define what "better" looks like so we have something to improve against.

Within the first 6 months, you'll:

  • Own the underwriting and fraud detection systems end to end.

  • Influence the RC Capital product roadmap with data-backed proposals on what to build next.

  • Be the person who knows best how RevenueCat's revenue data translates into financial risk signals.

Within the first 12 months, you'll:

  • Lead new Data initiatives as the Capital product line expands beyond Daily Payouts.

  • Help shape how Data Science operates within Capital as the team grows.

  • Have had a material impact on how RevenueCat deploys capital and manages risk at scale.

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • Fully remote and flexible work environment

  • 4-5 weeks of suggested time off annually for mental, physical, and emotional recharge

  • $2,000 USD for workspace setup and $1,000 USD annual stipend for continuous learning

Curious about the interview process? Discover more in our blog post about how we hire and learn tips to help you succeed.

About NetDocuments

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
  • Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace

NetDocuments is seeking a Legal Engineer. This exciting new role sits at the intersection of legal practice, software development and product management. The Legal Engineering team will have primary responsibility for evaluating and improving the performance of NetDocuments’ systems and products on tasks that require legal knowledge for quality assurance. Legal Engineering is an enablement team serving our product teams, not external customers. Legal Engineers will have responsibility for designing and implementing legal quality assurance evaluations and implementing platforms to support that work. Legal Engineers will also be tasked with discovering, proving, and recommending methods to improve legal quality in NetDocuments’ systems and allow our customers to get more value from their data.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer

About us

We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.
